instance.title: Instance
instance.description: Settings for everyone on this Fileship instance. Values set here override the environment.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: Limits and processing for uploaded files.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Let people create their own accounts from the login page.

turnstile.title: Turnstile
turnstile.description: Cloudflare Turnstile protects the login and sign up forms from bots.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Captions, smart search and sensitive content detection.

fields.returnHttpsDescription: Protocol used in the links Fileship generates.
fields.fileChunkSizeDescription: Large files are uploaded in pieces of this size.
fields.trashRetentionDaysDescription: Deleted items stay in the trash this long. 0 deletes them immediately.
fields.removeExifDataDescription: Strip location and camera details from uploaded images.
fields.registrationEnabledDescription: Show a sign up link on the login page.
fields.turnstileSecretKeyDescription: Turnstile only turns on when both keys are set. A wrong secret blocks every login.
fields.aiEnabledDescription: Process uploads with the local AI models.
fields.aiPresetDescription: Larger presets use more accurate models. Changing it analyzes every file again in the background.
fields.aiJobLeaseMsDescription: A job whose server stops responding for this long is picked up again.
fields.telemetryEnabledDescription: Share anonymous usage statistics to help improve Fileship.

ai.resetDescription: Captions, OCR text, search data and sensitive content flags of every file are deleted and every file is analyzed again in the background. Choices made with Not sensitive or Mark as sensitive are kept.
ai.analyzingAgain: Analyzing {n} file again | Analyzing {n} files again

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Where uploads and backups are kept. New ones go to the active storage, existing ones stay where they were written. Already have files on a storage? Add it here and use Import files to bring them into Fileship.
storage.importedTitle: Imported {n} file from {name} | Imported {n} files from {name}
storage.importedDescription: {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed. Files the user already had or that did not fit their storage limit are skipped; the Logs page has the details.
storage.migrateDescription: Every file and backup on other storages is copied here and then removed from where it was. This can take a while.
storage.deleteDescription: Fileship forgets this storage. Nothing is deleted from the storage itself.

storageDialog.description: The connection is tested before saving. Secrets are stored encrypted.
storageDialog.name: Name

storageFields.endpointDescription: Leave empty for AWS. Needed for R2, MinIO and other S3 services.
storageFields.forcePathStyleDescription: Needed by MinIO and some self-hosted S3 services.
storageFields.privateKeyDescription: Use a password, a private key or both.

import.title: Import files from {name}
import.description: Brings files that Fileship has no record of into a user's account.
import.localHint: Put the files you want to import in this folder on the server. Files in {folder} that Fileship has no record of are imported too.
import.storageHint: Every file on this storage that Fileship has no record of is imported, except Fileship's own {folder} folder.
import.ruleMoved: Files are moved into {folder} on this storage, so their old paths stop working.
import.ruleFolders: The first folder of each path becomes a Fileship folder. Deeper folders are merged into it.
import.ruleDuplicates: Files the user already has with the same name and size are skipped, so running it again is safe.
import.ruleRecent: Files changed in the last 15 minutes are left for the next run.
import.nothingStorage: Every file on this storage is already in Fileship.
import.nothingLocal: Put files in the folder above, then check again.
